checked.claim: Each clock change turns the curtain in its own direction from one pure planner
checked.why: transitionFor answers top for an hour forward, bottom for a new day or a rewind, centre for the Eclipse in and inward for its end at 1400 ms; onClockHeard hands it to glass.mjs hintTurn, held 1.5 s (TURN_HINT_MS). The drawn turn is not read headless, as the reader says.

checked.claim: Six flash groups at 0, 360, 900, 1320, 1930, 2400 ms with Pane flash each; never more than three in a second
checked.why: INVESTIGATION_ONSETS is those six; each onset's timer runs flicker() and playFlashSound() together; the most onsets in any 1000 ms window is 3 (0/360/900 and 360/900/1320). The sound once per onset is by reading alone, as the reader says.

checked.why: onBodyAnnounced returns null for payload.rehearsal and otherwise lights drpg-flicker at DISCOVERY_ONSETS; the stylesheet lights #drpg-hud, #drpg-status, #drpg-despair and #drpg-notices-corner when the body is not under the glass class.

checked.why: Each heard change calls clearFlashes and holdEscape replaces the held skip; onEscape runs the held skip once when no sequence runs.

checked.why: onClockHeard returns before hintTurn and the flash timers when !on || still.

checked.why: slidePhase returns null with no old label, the same label or ms 0, else animates translateX(24px) to 0; renderHud reads the old label before the rebuild and calls it.

checked.claim: The day summary and the body's card stand centred over the windows until touched; centre honoured from a GM's card only
checked.why: showDaySummary passes centre: true; body.mjs writes popupCentre; popup.mjs honours the flag only when the card's writer is a GM and raises the card until the first pointerdown.

checked.claim: The day summary waits for the turn; rows 160 ms apart from 150 ms; none under reduced motion
checked.why: sumUp sets the summary on a timer of summaryDelay, the turn's length; the stylesheet's delay is calc(150ms + var(--drpg-row) * 160ms) and none under drpg-reduced-motion.

checked.claim: A Spectator has no Stop on its sheet, and with no GM its safeword press is refused by its own chat block while the press reports success
checked.why: Traced: sheetMode answers safeword false for a Spectator (pinned 'no Stop' by R3857), sheet-sidebar returns before drawing the button. With no GM, safewordPoster answers 'caller', callSafeword calls announce -> privately -> ChatMessage.create on the Spectator's own browser; refuseOwnMessage (preCreateChatMessage) answers false for this user's own message when spectatorViewer() holds, with no exception for the safeword card; callSafeword then logs and returns true. In the awaitCard road the selfPosted note is added after announce whatever it returned. The GM handbook says anyone may press it, a Spectator included, and that every sheet carries the button. Not refuted: no guard elsewhere and no test pins the opposite. Foundry's quiet cancel on a preCreate false is its documented behaviour, not read at a table.

new_observations.title: The end-of-day board takes every click on every screen for its 6 s
new_observations.what: The sequence host is pointer-events auto; only the start-of-day board and the case summary are set to none. Since 13.11.2026 the end board plays alone when Night begins, so for about 6 s (Esc earlier) no screen at the table takes a click on the map or a window.
new_observations.failure_scenario: The GM presses Next time of day from Evening; for six seconds the GM's and every player's clicks on the canvas and on open windows land on the board, until it fades or Esc.
new_observations.refutation_tried: Searched all stylesheets for another pointer-events rule on #drpg-sequence or .drpg-sequence-dayEnd (none); R3715 reads the computed pointer-events of a dayStart host only; the 1.2.109 notes promise the click-through for the start board alone, so the owner may mean the end board to hold the screen.

new_observations.title: A late browser's catch-up can pick the Final Trial's verdict card and play nothing
new_observations.what: lateSequence counts every GM message with verdictAt as a verdictCut event; the Final Trial's card carries verdictAt and no verdictCut, so when it is the newest fresh event catchUpSequences calls playVerdictCut, verdictBoard answers null, and an older event still inside the 10 minutes is not played.
new_observations.failure_scenario: A player reloads within 10 minutes of the Final Trial's verdict and its case summary board; the late pick is the verdict card, which draws nothing, and the summary board they missed is not played.
new_observations.refutation_tried: Read lateSequence for a verdictCut flag check (it reads verdictAt only); read finalVerdictCard's flags. Whether a Final Trial's case summary falls inside the same 10 minutes is the table's.
